source_shapes: Variant1 has three small upper fronts, two middle fronts plus a partial/recessed right compartment, unequal-width lower fronts and one broad bottom drawer. Gold-role marks are upper-center, middle-left and broad bottom front.

Variant2 has a small gold-role storage box with two short metal projections above the cabinet, two rows of narrow mixed-height fronts, a large lower-left door and a lower-right recess/shelf with small nested storage blocks. These ambiguous tiny marks are not evidence for a radio, robot or electronics.

palette.rule: Neutral metal case/fronts receive native c. Source-selected fronts/trim receive W. Gold during refinement identifies detail ownership; production layers must be neutral.

donor_reference.role: Actual installed Vanilla Furniture Expanded filing cabinet supplies restrained galvanized-metal bevels, recessed pulls and clean game-art edge weight. Its two equal drawers, facing model, research bonus and donor palette are not copied.

construction: Editable cabinet bodies preserve each source layout, assorted rectangular front sizes, recesses, top storage block and short base supports. Closed metal faces are filled authored surfaces: a tiny outline glyph does not establish physically transparent drawer panels. Partial source marks are represented as recessed storage without inventing a dynamic open state.
states: Two actual RandomTile cosmetic layouts; each receives S/E/N/W authoring. No new open/closed state. South remains proposed fixed native tile; all extra directions unbound.
inventory_boundary: Argyve child changes InventoryPopulationTable to Argyve Cabinet but does not change render/shape. Actual inventory remains native and is not drawn as invented visible loot.

frame.rule: One full-cell coordinate mapping for each complete layout and all tint masks. No independent drawer or top-box bbox centering.

native_behavior: Preserve solid200-weight metal container, occluding=true, native inventory/smart-use and source random selection. No donor research/storage mechanics are transplanted.
native_acceptance: Pending full-set generation gate; no runtime activation, native orientation/footprint or container acceptance.

directional_reference.mapping: Same square2x2 draw frame for S/E/N; source pixels have transparent margins. Actual alpha widths124/83/124; E/S=0.669. This informs a plausible cabinet end, not a measured Qud footprint or copied damage rectangle.

camera.contract: Straight cardinal front, complete end, back and explicit west; vertical axes parallel. Shallow top bevel inherited from accepted fronts. No yaw or convergence of structural walls.
camera.front_review: Existing fronts have straight vertical sides and only a shallow cap bevel; comparison with actual reference supports retaining them. No redraw is required to remove a three-quarter camera.
camera.depth_status: Authored hidden depth informed by actual directional reference; upright Qud glyph does not establish it.
camera.unseen: Plain galvanized side and rear panels with restrained folded-edge seams and short feet. These are authored surfaces, not source-established extra drawers, vents, machinery or storage states.
camera.variant2: Same top storage box and two metal brackets; front handle does not appear on the rear/end. Rear x reflects the front x about shared pivot. Brackets overlap in end views. No radio/electronic interpretation.

refinement: Reuse the two actual v1 front refinements. Front-guided missing-view refinement per layout, followed by fixed-geometry material transfer; no second isolation generation.
